subject: Cohort of self-serve credits flagged — suspected bot cluster (Siffin Tech)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Alert: Self-serve credit cluster flagged (Siffin Tech prospects)

Hi team,

Ran the daily anti-abuse sweep and it flagged a small cohort of trial signups that were auto-granted self-serve credits this morning. Pattern looks like: same IP subnet, sequential emails (ricardo.gomez+1@siffin.tech, ricardo.gomez+2@...), identical user-agent string, and rapid token usage within the first 30 minutes.

I've attached a CSV with the signup rows and an IP-cluster PDF. Two external identifiers are associated: ricardo.gomez@siffin.tech (appears to be a real contact) and an ops address from streamline.ai used as a forwarding/notify.

Initial ask: can sales confirm whether these were expected bulk signups from Siffin (they're trialing multiple seats), or should we treat as suspected bot/duplicate-account abuse and revoke credits & disable self-serve for the cohort?

If we revoke, recommend:
- Immediate rollback of issued credits for the 12 suspect accounts (audit log attached)
- Hold on promo extensions for any Siffin-linked domains until manual review
- Open a Zendesk ticket to request evidence if external contact disputes revocation

Cc'ing Karthik to confirm commercial intent and Monica for CS handoff if we need to escalate.

Thanks,
--
Soojin Lee
Risk & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
security@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Alert: Self-serve credit cluster flagged (Siffin Tech prospects)

Thanks, Soojin — useful summary.

Quick notes from my side: we have an open MQL from ricardo.gomez@siffin.tech but there was no explicit request for volume seats. Sales motion has not yet engaged with Siffin engineering to set up a POC. My hunch: this is not a sanctioned bulk onboarding.

Can CS/Trust do the following while I ping Ricardo?
- Temporarily freeze further self-serve credit grants for *@siffin.tech
- Suspend token usage for the suspect accounts (soft throttle, preserve logs)
- Prepare a short evidence pack to send should Ricardo push back (screenshot + timestamps + IPs)

Monica — can you own the external outreach if we need to escalate to the customer-facing track? I'll call Ricardo if required.

If we confirm bot/abuse, we should also consider a 30-day hold on promo issuance for the siffin.tech domain and mark the lead as suspect in HubSpot.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Alert: Self-serve credit cluster flagged (Siffin Tech prospects)

Adding context from CS side — I pulled the recent conversation thread in HubSpot and there was a demo requested by a generic ops contact (ops@streamline.ai) 3 days ago. No signed NDA, no SSO/SCIM setup, and no billing/account owner verified. The account properties show "Company name: Siffin Tech" but the contact looks like an intermediary.

Plan: I'll draft a polite outreach asking for:
- Confirmation that these signups were initiated by an authorized Siffin employee
- Intended number of seats and POC scope
- Company domain owner or billing contact

If we don't hear back in 24 hours, I recommend we revoke the credits for the suspicious accounts and mark the lead as "needs verification". I'll prepare the Zendesk ticket and attach the log bundle.

Monica Patel
Customer Success
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: Ricardo Gomez <ricardo.gomez@siffin.tech>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@streamline.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 13:05:00 -06:00
Subject: Re: Cohort of self-serve credits flagged — suspected bot cluster (Siffin Tech)

Hi Karthik / Monica,

Thanks for flagging — I'm Ricardo (Platform Lead at Siffin Tech). We did run an internal script to spin up trial accounts for a pilot environment this morning, but that should have been communicated by our infra team. Ops@streamline.ai is our external contractor running the test harness.

I can verify that the signups came from our side; I'll ask infra to provide a short confirmation email from their side with IP ranges and purpose. For now, please pause any punitive actions — we are a real customer and don't want credits revoked while we confirm.

I will get the infra note within the hour. Apologies for the confusion.

Regards,
Ricardo Gomez
Platform Lead, Siffin Tech
ricardo.gomez@siffin.tech

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 17:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cohort of self-serve credits flagged — suspected bot cluster (Siffin Tech)

Update: received signed confirmation from Siffin infra (see Zendesk ticket 5238 and attached infra note in Drive). Their infra team confirmed the tests and provided the IP ranges and user-agent strings we saw. Ops@streamline.ai is a contracted partner — they provided an indemnity note.

Resolution steps completed this afternoon: 
- Cleared the suspension for the verified accounts and re-applied the originally issued credits
- Added a 2-step verification requirement for further bulk grants (manual verification in CS for any >5 accounts from same domain within 24h)
- Logged the incident as "verified bulk test" in the abuse tracker and set domain hold-waiver for siffin.tech for 7 days while they complete POC onboarding

I'll leave the Zendesk ticket open for 7 days for auditability; if anything else pops up we'll reopen.

Thanks all — good cross-team work.

--
Soojin Lee
Risk & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
security@redwood.ai
